text:
Aisha (PM): kicking off sync — customer asks incoming: multiple enterprise customers requested native 4096 and 8192 embedding dims + ability to return multiple dimensioned vectors in a single call. want quick decision: MVP scope?
Sam (eng-platform): high-level: supporting 4096 is doable on hosted with model variants; 8192 hits memory + perf limits unless we put on Dedicated. batching window also matters — bigger dims -> fewer items per batch -> throughput drops.
Maria (eng-ml): model selection note: text-embedding-3-large supports up to 4096 comfortably. For 8192 we either need model sharding or a new model family. Quantization helps but increases CPU/GPU kernel complexity.
Devin (SE): customer ask: "one request -> array of vectors with different dims" — is that required, or can we ask them to split requests?
Clara (CS): customers (fintech and search vendors) want single-call convenience for latency reasons. They also want backcompat: many clients already assume flat array in response.
Aisha (PM): options on table: (A) MVP: support single-dim per request (clients pick dim param) + up to 4096 on hosted. (B) MVP+: allow multi-dim within a request returning nested arrays. (C) Enterprise-only 8192 via Dedicated/private. Thoughts on prioritization?
Sam (eng-platform): prefer (A) to reduce server complexity and keep SLOs predictable. (B) requires response format change and heavier validation. We could add an opt-in flag later.
Maria (eng-ml): from model ops POV (A) lowest risk. (B) is extra work for response marshalling and adds ambiguity for caching/batching (prefix caching per-dim). Also measuring quality across dims is tricky.
Devin (SE): tradeoffs for clients: (A) means they do two calls if they need multiple dims, increasing tail latency and token cost. But (B) will force us to define canonical HTTP payload shape. If we do (B) we should standardize: {"embeddings": [{"dim":4096, "vectors":[...]}, ...]} rather than a flat mixed array.
Aisha (PM): agree on explicit shape. we need backcompat; existing API returns {"data": [{"embedding": [...]}, ...]}. If we add nested dim groups, how do we keep old clients working?
Sam (eng-platform): plan: keep existing top-level "data" for single-dim requests. For multi-dim requests require a new parameter `multi_dim=true` and return structure under `data_v2` or upgrade `data` with clear schema version header. Avoid silent breaking changes.
Clara (CS): customers will accept a flag. ask: what are launch criteria? they want latency <= 200ms p95 for small batch (<=8) at 4096.
Maria (eng-ml): can aim for 200ms p95 on hosted for 4096 with optimized kernels and batching constraints (max batch size 16 for 4096). We'll need perf tests and one week of Canary before GA.
Sam (eng-platform): infra changes: enforce per-model batch caps, add per-tenant mem guardrails, and route 8192 to Dedicated. Also expose "max_batch_size" in model metadata so SDKs can auto-split.
Devin (SE): developer ergonomics: SDK should auto-split if payload > max_batch_size and optionally auto-aggregate multiple dims into parallel requests. We should add a helpful error: HTTP 431 with explanation when request exceeds limits.
Aisha (PM): proposal: MVP (2 wks):
- Support single-dim per request
- Host up to 4096 dims on hosted (model: text-embedding-3-large)
- Expose model metadata with max_dim and max_batch_size
- SDK auto-split guidance + clear 431 errors
- Docs for multi-dim workflow (customers do client-side fanout)
Launch criteria: perf tests meeting p95 latency targets, docs + SDK update, CS OK, one-week canary.
Sam (eng-platform): sounds reasonable. For the roadmap, mark 8192 as "Enterprise + Dedicated" Q3 and multi-dim server-side as Q4 exploratory.
Maria (eng-ml): can commit to perf tuning and creating quality evals for 4096 within 2 weeks. For 8192 need model research — estimate 6-8 weeks.
Clara (CS): I'll start customer comms with the caveat: hosted 4096 available in beta; 8192 enterprise path; multi-dim server-side later.
Devin (SE): small implementation note for the spec: include example responses. Add a snippet in docs: ```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.01, ...], "model": "text-embedding-3-large", "dim": 4096}
  ]
}
```
and multi-dim (future): ```json
{
  "data_v2": [
    {"dim": 4096, "vectors": [[...],[...]]},
    {"dim": 1024, "vectors": [[...]]}
  ]
}
```
Aisha (PM): next steps: Sam/Maria/Devin to produce implementation RFC and perf plan by EOD Friday. Clara will collect top-3 customers to invite to beta. I'll create tracker ticket.
Sam (eng-platform): on it. I'll add model metadata endpoint and a small API flag for `multi_dim` in the RFC.
Maria (eng-ml): will add perf scripts and bench harness.
Devin (SE): will draft SDK split behavior and example code.
deploy-bot: deployment note: scheduled canary lane available Monday 08:00 UTC. :rocket:
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone — syncing again Friday 10am to approve RFC and beta invite list. :thumbsup:
